title: Microsoft Teams: Focus on the conversation while Facilitator in Teams mobile takes the notes, now with speaker attribution
description: Use Facilitator in Teams mobile to turn in-person conversations into useful notes and follow-ups with speaker attribution. Start note-taking from your phone and let Facilitator capture and transcribe the ad hoc discussion, with speaker attribution helping distinguish who said what. Facilitator uses the conversation to generate notes, summaries, and follow-up actions, giving you a richer record of the discussion while letting you stay more present in the moment.
